**ID:** T1474

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle compendium of the precepts for *śrāmaṇerī* 沙彌尼 (novice nuns). Translator and date unknown; the catalog tradition assigns it to "lost translation".

**Abstract**

The text presents the ten precepts and associated behavioural norms for the *śrāmaṇerī* — the female counterpart to the *śrāmaṇera* ([KR6k0060](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0060)–0062). Together with [KR6k0064](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0064) (*Shāmínī líjièwén*) it constitutes the foundational practical Vinaya for the early-medieval Chinese *śrāmaṇerī*-saṅgha.
